“Ryan?”
Eloise had given up on high society after an unknown and mysterious illness, choosing instead to live in the countryside of Feltham. She adored this quiet, open place with its fresh air — far from the bustling city.
One day, a new overseer arrived at Blissbury Manor, the estate managed by her father.
He bore the same name as Lieutenant Colonel Ryan Wilgrave, the man she had long admired and secretly yearned for.
But this Ryan was nothing like the one she had dreamt of.
He looked at Eloise with pure disdain.
“So, you’re not just a thief — you’re a depraved and lecherous one at that. Do you enjoy spending your lonely nights with these kinds of paintings?”
In his hands was a nude painting, modelled after the face in Ryan Wilgrave’s portrait!
Eloise was certain. From his filthy appearance, his vulgar words, and his blatant disrespect towards women, this man was nothing but a scoundrel who had infiltrated Blissbury with ill intent.
If not that, he was an absolute disgrace of a deserter!
“I see you’ve never actually met the model, Miss Eloise.”
Glancing down, he smirked.
“It’s not that small.”
Their first encounter was, without a doubt, the absolute worst.

106439.synopsis:
Lin Hening’s boyfriend cheated on him. And he even had the audacity to justify it:
“He’s gentler than you, more understanding. I make soup for him every day. I just like him.”
Later, Lin Hening got into a car accident. He was driving a Ferrari. The other driver? A second-hand minivan.
Lin Hening: …
Through the car window, he saw the culprit—a buzz-cut guy in a short-sleeved shirt, towering and imposing, like a night-hunting falcon.
Lin Hening had no doubt this man could easily lift him and his car, then make him disappear without a trace.
The driver asked if he was okay.
Lin Hening had a sprained ankle, a fractured arm, and—oh, the car door wouldn’t open.
The driver thought for two seconds. Then he ripped the car door off with his bare hands!
Next, he stuffed Lin Hening into the minivan, stepped on the gas, and drove straight to the hospital.
When Lin Hening came out of the examination room, the driver said, “How do you want me to compensate you? … Don’t forget to count the car door.”
—
His ex wanted to get back together.
Lin Hening called out toward the house, “Hey, babe—”
A man walked out of the kitchen, holding a spatula. “You hungry? The sweet and sour ribs, braised carp, and soy-braised pork knuckles are almost ready.”
He’s reliable, obedient, and loyal. He cooks me full-course feasts every day. I’m absolutely in love.
—
Looking back on their first meeting, the thing that first caught Lin Hening’s eye was how the man’s sweat-dampened shirt clung to his rock-solid abs, outlining every muscle in his eight-pack.
So much raw strength!
…And stamina.
Refined, elegant, and aloof beauty (uke) × Domestic, practical, and built-like-a-tank attack dog (seme).

106951.synopsis:
Gu Rong is a two-year-old zombie toddler. Because he’s so tiny, his little legs can’t carry him fast enough to catch any prey, leaving him with an empty tummy every day. Prey would practically stroll right under his nose, and just as he’d try to scramble up to chase them, thud – he’d faceplant.
Then, Gu Rong wakes up to find he’s been transported into a horror game, becoming the smallest NPC in the whole thing. NPCs make their living by scaring players, but Gu Rong is just too darn cute. His soft, squishy appearance isn’t scary at all. Players take one look at this miniature NPC, do a double-take, and then completely melt!
Gu Rong wraps his arms around a player’s leg, tiny fists pummeling their shin in what feels more like a tickle: “Gonna get you, gonna get you!”
A player offers him a dried fish snack.
Gu Rong clutches the little fish and gobbles it down with gusto, making happy “mmm” sounds.
Believing he’s earning his food by scaring players, Gu Rong sets off on a path of, well, terrifying (read: endearing) the players to death.
The little zombie cub hops and skips, but he can’t even jump over a measly twenty-centimeter “chasm.” The poor kiddo has to take a detour, going a whole hundred meters out of his way. By the time he gets there, the player has effortlessly hopped across. The little zombie keeps hopping, and after an hour, he’s so hungry he’s hopping and wiping away tears with his tiny hands.
A player rushes over and scoops up the little zombie. They dig into their own pockets, using their points to redeem a huge bag of food for the little cub.
Player: “Okay, okay, I’ll just come to you so you can scare me, how about that?”
The player even coaches the little guy on how to be scary: “Good, good, hold that pose. You’re already, like, two percent scary.”
Players enter the game, all eagerly waiting for the little cub to pop out and “scare” them.
Players, loaded down with piles of snacks and drinks, sit waiting: “Why isn’t he out yet?”
Livestream chat: “This is a horror game! You’re supposed to be beating levels, not feeding the NPC cub!”
Audience: “Form an orderly line, please! No shoving, no fighting, and absolutely no junk food!”
Whenever a player shares the screen with the little cub, their livestream viewership explodes.
Players: “You’re here to watch us beat the game, not to watch this little guy!”
But later…
A player is trying to complete a task, and the audience is having none of it: “What are you even doing? We want to see the cub! Show us the cub!”
The player, down to their last sliver of health and about to die: “…” “You guys don’t care about me at all, do you?!”
Players gradually realize that the more they’re on screen with the little cub, the more viewers they get. They’ve instantly cracked the code for getting views.
Now, every player who enters the game starts actively searching for the cub, eagerly volunteering to be “scared,” and, of course, showering him with all sorts of tasty treats and drinks.
The little cub, who used to be constantly hungry, is now plump and round, like a little dumpling. He still believes he’s so scary that players are willingly offering him food.
The little cub screws up his face in a “scary” grimace and toddles off to “terrify” another player, letting out a ferocious roar: “Rawr!”

109255.synopsis:
Kageyama Shogo is the only member of the broadcasting club at Akihito High School. He has worked hard on the school radio program, but unfortunately it is in danger of being discontinued.
So he devised a plan to solicit and answer anonymous love advice from the entire school.
The project, which he had been prepared to abandon, was surprisingly well received, and the broadcasting club was spared from the danger of extinction !
However, for some reason, after he started the love counseling project, some of the most famous and beautiful girls in the school started approaching him…….?
This is a blind romantic comedy based on love counseling ! Please enjoy ! !

109767.synopsis:
Kim Heewon, an eloquent and quick-witted chief secretary. It’s already been six years since he became the right-hand man of Executive Director Kwon Young-jae, who’s notorious for being extremely difficult to work with. 
People often ask him how he manages such a grueling job. And every time, Kim Heewon simply answers that turns out, being a secretary was his true calling.
“Do you know how old Secretary Kim is?”
“……”
“You’re telling me a thirty-one-year-old man just presented as an omega? And I’m supposed to believe that?”
But then he did present as an omega. Naturally, Kwon Young-jae, who suffers from a serious omega-related neurosis, was furious.
“Sir, thank you for everything until now.”
“I didn’t know you were this irresponsible.”
“You, more than anyone, should know it’s impossible for us to keep working together.”
Heewon resigned according to proper procedures and fully embraced the sweet life of unemployment. Meanwhile, Kwon Young-jae’s daily life fell apart without Secretary Kim. 
Eventually, the proud Executive Director Kwon begins his desperate persuasion. His condition is just one: Come back to work!
“What if—just what if—one of us goes into heat?”
“You think you and I could actually cause that kind of trouble?”
“…We do have a history, you know.”
Can Executive Director Kwon and Secretary Kim really keep things strictly professional?
associated_names: Being a Secretary is My Calling
Being Secretary was My True calling

110023.synopsis:

111047.synopsis:
With the decline of the six ancient divine clans and the rise of humanity, the continent was plunged into endless strife and shifting power. Amidst the chaos and suffering of this turbulent era, an unknown knight rose to prominence. After more than two decades of relentless warfare, he brought an end to the age of discord
He slew the cruel tyrant, shielded the young imperial princess as she ascended the throne, yet was ultimately stripped of his authority.
He saved the elven princess, defended the sacred lands of the elves from the ravages of war, yet faced exclusion and disdain from the very people he protected.
He aided the Fox Empress of Kyushu in purging corrupt officials and securing her reign, only to be betrayed in return.
He helped a fox-dancer from the Sakura Tribe escape her lowly status and assisted her in becoming a high-ranking official, only to be used and discarded as a stepping stone.
He cleansed the kingdom of a heretical cult’s corruption, only to be burdened with false accusations.
Gazing upon this flourishing continent that no longer needed him, the knight silently withdrew, his duty fulfilled. Gratitude was never what he sought. The world was at peace, his purpose achieved.
No longer young, he drew his sword and struck at an opponent he could never defeat, marking the final note of his life’s symphony.
Yet death did not claim him. The fox bloodline within him saved his life, though at the cost of his gender. Forced into a new identity, she resolved to leave her knightly past behind and live quietly as an ordinary person.
Unbeknownst to her, the empresses and princesses who once held complex feelings for him now drowned in regret upon hearing news of his “death”…
associated_names: 她们认清感情，骑士却已转生幼狐

111815.synopsis:
Gu Qingcheng’s irresponsible father died suddenly. She inherited a fortune worth tens of billions of yuan inexplicably. She thought she could live a carefree life with the money, but she accidentally unlocked a space and learned that she had to travel through the 1970s! 
I heard that there was a shortage of food and clothing in that era, so you have to prepare early. Sweep through major shopping malls and granaries, and use your credit cards non-stop. Billions of supplies are all in the space! …But her stepsister tried her best to snatch her engagement, her stepmother wanted to squeeze the last bit of blood out of her, and her s*umbag father favored boys over girls and ignored her. 
The original body accepted it and didn’t even resist! They played more viciously than each other, and their methods were even more disgusting. How to play this useless hand? 
Watch as she turns the tables!
What? Her s*umbag father embezzled her mother’s pension?
Fine, then taking everything from the house wouldn’t be too much, would it? She wouldn’t leave them a single penny!
What? Her stepsister lied about being sick and didn’t want to go to the countryside?
Fine, she’d write a report and send her thousands of miles away to the far northwest!
What? The stepmother cheated on him while the s*umbag father was away?
Okay, such shocking news requires the s*umbag father to be present! Let’s stage a bloody scene to liven things up!
Once everything was settled, Gu Qingcheng took her billions of dollars worth of space and went with the army. 
There was no going back, so she might as well make her mark in this era!
Unexpectedly, the country assigned her a great husband.
A V-shaped waist, eight-pack abs.
From then on, her husband doted on her, her in-laws doted on her, and she inadvertently broke the ten-generation single-son rule in her in-laws’ family.

Tennouji-senpai, who’s usually cool and expressionless, just can’t seem to be honest without alcohol. Every night, she shows up at my place with a glass of highball in hand—getting close to me with a look she never shows anyone else…!?

116679.synopsis:
Zhou Qiongyue only wanted to lie flat and chill—
Instead, she transmigrated into a novel she once read, full of backstabbing household drama.
Worse yet, she wasn’t even the heroine.
That title belonged to Xie Zixin, the legitimate daughter of Marquis Xuanping, Lord Xie.
And the male lead? None other than Zhou Qiongyue’s own childhood friend and cousin—the Second Prince.
As for her role?
Just a love-struck supporting character.
A devoted simp who clung to her Second Prince cousin, eventually becoming one of his many concubines—all for the sake of boosting his career.
And in the end? She was used, discarded, and killed off.
Thinking about her grim ending, Zhou Qiongyue shuddered.
That cousin of hers was way too dangerous.
Better to leave him to the female lead!
She’s rich, she’s got a powerful backer—she just wants to find a decent young man and live a peaceful life.
Too bad the original heroine isn’t having it.
She insists on making life miserable for her.
Well then.
Zhou Qiongyue didn’t want to fight, but she wasn’t about to sit there and take a beating either.
Before she even figured out who to marry, a suitor crashed into her life.
Tall, handsome, high status, orphaned parents…
Wait a minute—
Isn’t this her long-lost “fated husband”?
Fine. She’ll marry him.
But after the wedding, Zhou Qiongyue starts to notice something off.
The longer she’s around him…
The more she realizes—
This guy is completely insane!

118471.synopsis:
After Mi Jia’s death, he was bound to a live streaming system and gained a special skill: [Love Cultivation] 
The system told him that people who died accidentally would be thrown into an infinite doomsday game to get a chance to be reborn.
The game process would be shown live to audiences of various high-level worlds. Survivors could get extra rewards from the audience through the live stream. However, the difficulty of survival might be increased due to the audience’s negative reviews, so don’t provoke the audience.
Mi Jia: Okay! (madly provoking…)
…
Viewers who saw Mi Jia’s profile card: “A survivor with 0 intelligence is useless. He’ll probably die in the novice zone.” They quickly left a negative review.
However, they were slapped in the face by the very first world.
As the zombie wave approached, a group of survivors used all their skills to escape, while Mi Jia, unfazed, transformed into a zombie and joined the enemy ranks.
He also smashed the heads of other zombies with one punch and fed their crystal cores to the Zombie King.
Audience: ????
Mi Jia looked at the favorability bar on the Zombie King’s head and fell into deep thought: “100 crystal cores for a little bit of increase? This favorability is too hard to raise!”
System 007: Friendly reminder, a kiss can add 20 points oh~
……
——————————————
The doomsday world was His paradise.
——————————————

[Solo Instance: Deserted Village Strange Tales]

…

118727.synopsis: All I’m doing is living alone, so why do I keep getting stronger?

119495.synopsis:
Born with a flawed class, Do-Jin burned his life away chasing the rankings but still fell to 998th place. His name became a mark of failure, and his life sank to the lowest rung of the world.
Then a miracle reached the man the world had cast aside as flawed. This time, change was no longer something he could avoid. This time, Do-Jin would tear himself free from the fate written over his life and carve out a future with his own hands.

120007.synopsis:
Lin Kuo was dragged into a horror survival game. The entire process was livestreamed, and viewers could send him survival items as tips.
While others would suck up to the audience—shamelessly calling them “daddy” just to get rewards—
Lin Kuo coldly made a throat-slitting gesture to the camera, face expressionless.
The livestream comments exploded:
[The last guy with this much attitude already has weeds two meters tall on his grave.] 
[Just waiting for him to drop dead.] 
[No way I’m ever donating a single item to this guy.] 
Even Sheng Wen, who randomly clicked into the stream, commented: “That’s it?”
In a survival game themed around “Deception”, Lin Kuo used his enemies’ tricks against them.
The vengeful red-clad ghost haunting him every night was lured and trapped by his bait tactics.
Mutated creatures that swarmed him were obliterated when he blew up their nest.
—
The comments fell into stunned silence.
Now they regret not helping him…
But it’s too late.
Somehow, Lin Kuo stopped resisting the livestream.
He even started chatting with the audience:
Lin Kuo: That invisibility card? My boyfriend sent it. The quest clue? Also from my boyfriend.
Lin Kuo: You don’t have to donate anything for me. My boyfriend has already prepared everything.
Lin Kuo: …Who’s my boyfriend? (blushes)
Viewers: WHO?! WHO IS IT?! WHO’S THE BOYFRIEND?!
Sheng Wen: (*￣︶￣)

125383.synopsis:
Gi Dowoon ends up with a massive debt the moment he’s discharged from the military.
Cornered and on the run from debt collectors, he takes a “clerical part-time job” based solely on the condition that it includes room and board.
But it turns out—the job is at a gangster office!
Shuffling between the mob’s office and their bar, Dowoon meets a suspicious man who looks like an unemployed local, Han Sangyoung.
“Hey, princess. Where you runnin’ off to again?”
At first, he thinks Sangyoung is just a weird guy speaking in dialect, but the more time they spend together, the more Sangyoung makes him smile…
Someone who closes the distance by calling him “princess,” despite Dowoon only ever being called “good-looking” all his life.
Someone who seemed rough and indifferent, yet constantly throws him off with unexpected actions.
“An acquaintance who’s a gangster? That’s supposed to make it better?”
“…Not just any gangster… he’s a familiar gangster… so that’s… a kind of distinction… I guess. Also, he sort of feels like… my backing…”
He’s fed up with that annoying gangster he hates, but also kind of feels protected because of the one he knows.
This confusing emotion— a romance so rough it sends chills down your spine…
Where is the final destination of this unsettling feeling?

129223.synopsis:
Xiao Ye is a chatterbox—affectionate, relentlessly talkative, and a sunshine-bright helper to everyone. He’s grown up alongside his childhood best friend, his bamboo horse companion.  
But after college, everything changes. His best friend comes out, starts dating a boyfriend, and suddenly drifts away—growing cold and distant. When Xiao Ye asks why, the reply cuts deep:
“Listening to you yap all day is exhausting. Following me around, ‘Big Brother this, Big Brother that’… You’re so clingy. Don’t you realize how annoying you are?”  
Xiao Ye’s world shatters.
All this time… he hated me.
That day, the rain poured relentlessly.  
Xiao Ye transforms—into a quiet, withdrawn loner, a shadow of his former self.
Years later, he’s a silent, unassuming corporate drone.  
Three years into his job, his long-lost best friend stumbles drunk to his doorstep.
“Xiao Ye, I… actually, I—”
“Hold on.”  
A broad-shouldered, lean man steps forward, wrapping a towel around Xiao Ye’s damp hair. He pulls Xiao Ye into his arms from behind, shielding him as he glares down at the intruder.
“Alright. Say what you came to say.”  
You threw him away so easily, thinking you could pick him back up later—only to find someone else had already taken him home.  
Traumatized, withdrawn uke × Long-time secret admirer childhood friend seme
associated_names: 黏糊糊的话唠小狗也会惹人烦吗

133831.synopsis:
“Seducing the so called witch and bringing her as a partner to the New Year’s gala.”
For Edgar de Grace, dazzlingly handsome, silver tongued, gentle and gentlemanly to all, what bet could be easier? All the more because the target was Angela Faber, the dollmaker nicknamed “witch” who already nursed a quiet crush on him.
“Angela, please… Then curse me instead. Slap me, grab me by the collar, shake me, tell me a bastard like me deserves to rot in hell. Just… hate me, if you must…”
Being used as a nobleman’s pastime was not what hurt.
“How could I possibly resent Your Grace? I was the fool who believed a wooden doll could be alive. I was the one who fluttered over a counterfeit love, not even knowing I had become the stakes of a bet.”
Only the betrayal, that the man to whom she gave everything, whom she loved with all her heart, had thrown her aside, hurt as though her heart had been smashed to pieces.
“Sob… no, please… The words I love you were not a lie. I am begging you, do not abandon me like this.”
Even watching him cry and cling so desperately, she could only suspect that this too was another lie, another deception.
“Eddy, from the moment you let me call you that, our ending was already decided.”
No matter how much he wept and repented, it was far too late to put back together Angela’s shattered heart and crumbled trust.

139975.synopsis:
After arriving in a fantasy world, Rhein discovers that his golden finger isn’t the usual skill-proficiency panel, but rather one that lets him kill monsters and collect their bloodlines.
…
The once black-and-white memorial portrait suddenly turned to color. The goblin icon instantly came to life — from its sharp fangs to the saliva dripping from its mouth, everything was vivid and lifelike. For a moment, it felt as though the goblin had come back to life.
Before Rhein could react, he suddenly felt his muscles tighten slightly. At the same time, his lower abdomen…
“What the…”
As he stared in confusion, his peripheral vision caught the attribute panel:
[Name: Rhein] 
[Class: Farmer] 
[Infused Bloodline: Common Goblin Bloodline] 
[Bloodline Talents: High-Speed Reproduction Lv2… Dexterity Lv1…] 
[Strength: 5] 
[Agility: 5 (+1)] 
[Constitution: 5] 
[Intelligence: 7] 
[Perception: 5] 
[Charisma: 5] 
…
And so, when Rhein looked at powerful or mutated monsters, he often didn’t show the usual fear or dread of an adventurer,
but instead… eyes full of anticipation and desire.

167879.synopsis:
Tags: Male Rivalry + Shura Field + Crowd-Favorite + Group Pet + White Moonlight + All Male Leads Pure + Melodrama + Mary Sue Heroine Who Never Suffers
After dying suddenly, Jiang Mingtang transmigrates into a novel — as the vicious female supporting character doomed to a tragic fate.
The system informs her that if she successfully “captures” her target characters and earns the corresponding points, she can not only be reborn but also become fabulously wealthy.
Jiang Mingtang rubs her hands eagerly, brimming with confidence. She diligently charms each target one by one — and thus…
The dashing young general in bright armor indulges her without limits.
The noble and aloof prince climbs through her window at night, begging for just one glance of favor.
The gloomy, yandere imperial preceptor suppresses his dark gaze and demands she never leave his side.
The cunning and lazy playboy young master refuses to let go once he holds her.
Even the disciplined and proper aristocratic gentleman reddens his eyes, asking why she will not choose him.
…
In the end, they fight fiercely over her — even risking their lives.
One night, the system emits a piercing alarm:
“Host, this is bad! Your six hundred million is shooting at your one billion!”
Jiang Mingtang jolts awake from her dream — only to find herself surrounded by the rest of her targets:
“!!!”
She only wanted to make money.

178119.synopsis:
After just transmigrating to Azure Star, Yang Qi discovers that his reality has turned into a dating simulation game.
Everyone now has a dialogue box floating above their head.
At first, it’s only people—but soon, animals, diaries, even phones begin displaying dialogue boxes, becoming potential “targets” that can be pursued.
By the third day after transmigration, Yang Qi looks up at the dialogue box above the sun and falls into deep thought:
“You want me to pursue… the sun? Interesting.”
Short Version:
As long as there’s a dialogue box—even the sun is fair game.
associated_names: 我的现实变成了恋爱游戏

182215.synopsis:
Li Cunxin was transported to a primitive, uninhabited alien world where people lived like savages.
Unarmed, forced into wilderness survival—right from the start, it was hellish difficulty. It seemed even the heavens couldn’t bear to watch, and decided to grant her a talent.
The five-thousand-year fine tradition of Chinese civilization could not be abandoned. Li Cunxin decisively chose her talent: Agriculture.
Finding seeds, growing crops, ensuring she didn’t starve—but a society of one cannot develop. Just when Li Cunxin thought she would grow old and die alone in this foreign land, she found an injured, beautiful woman in the early winter snow and brought her back.
From then on, they picked up more and more fellow countrymen who had been transported to this other world, stranded in the wilderness, lost and helpless. Each person possessed a talent essential for survival.
In an environment with a complete knowledge base but absolutely no pre-existing technology, Li Cunxin led everyone from a primitive society toward an agricultural civilization: planting and weaving, animal husbandry, metallurgy and infrastructure. Human conflicts, tribal integration—from a single adobe house, a large village of fine homes took shape. Wasteland was reclaimed into vast fertile fields, achieving plenty in food and clothing, building a home in a foreign land.
Li Cunxin didn’t dare hope to fully restore modern technology; she only wished to reach the steam age in her lifetime and strive for a better life.
All of this was for the sake of the calls of “Village Chief” again and again.
associated_names: 从入门到精通的开荒生活

186055.synopsis:
In his previous life, Jiang Heng spent his entire life trapped in foolish filial piety. He gave everything he had to his younger brother and sister, believing it was his duty as the eldest son, all just to earn the approval of his parents and siblings.
When his two-year-old daughter developed a fever, he ignored it, thinking there was no need to make a fuss over something so minor. In the end, the fever turned into pneumonia, and the severe infection took the child’s life.
His wife, Si Nian, was left utterly broken. After divorcing him, she disappeared without a trace.
Jiang Heng believed that one day his sacrifices would be seen and acknowledged by his family. Yet when he was injured in a car accident and lay in the hospital in unbearable pain, his family took the compensation money and brought him straight back home, dumping him into the cowshed.
Because his leg was not treated in time, it was left permanently damaged. Every day the pain was so intense it felt worse than death. He barely clung to life for three years, witnessing more than enough of the coldness of the world.
He never expected that after he died, the only person who would come to collect his body would be his long-missing ex-wife. After she handled his funeral, his wandering soul watched her throw herself into a well and end her life.
When he opened his eyes again, he found himself back in the bitter winter of 1983, at the very moment his young daughter fell ill. In this life, he would cherish the people who truly deserved it.
